verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own MCP docs say it connects models to external MCP servers. Servers can be selected per request via `metadata.mcp_servers` or attached to an individual agent, so the product itself acts as an MCP client using those servers' tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed evidence on how servers are defined and configured (transports, server config format).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: LocalAI now supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling powerful agentic capabilities by connecting AI models to external tools and services.
Connect to external MCP servers for live data
Pass a comma-separated list of server names in `metadata.mcp_servers`
LocalAI's agents can also attach MCP servers to a single **agent**, independent of the model it runs on.
